title: 군검찰단의 조직에 관한 규정 / queue:ARTICLE:3:0:00003:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 3 (Head of the Ministry of National Defense Prosecutors' Office)
(1) The head of the Ministry of National Defense Prosecutors' Office appointed by the Minister of National Defense pursuant to Article 36 (3) of the Act (hereinafter referred to in this Article as the "Head of the Ministry of National Defense Prosecutors' Office") shall, under the orders of the Minister of National Defense, exercise overall control over the affairs under the Office's jurisdiction and direct and supervise military prosecutors assigned thereto.
(2) Where the position of Head of the Ministry of National Defense Prosecutors' Office is vacant or the Head is unable to perform his or her duties due to unavoidable circumstances, the senior division head and then the senior military prosecutor shall act on behalf of the Head, in that order.
